The correct expansion is
\[
1{,}003{,}003{,}001=10^9+3\cdot 10^6+3\cdot 10^3+1=1001^3.
\]
Since
\[
1001=7\cdot 11\cdot 13,
\]
we have
\[
1{,}003{,}003{,}001=7^3\cdot 11^3\cdot 13^3.
\]
For \(n=\prod p_i^{a_i}\), the number of ordered pairs \((x,y)\) with \(\operatorname{lcm}(x,y)=n\) is
\[
\prod_i (2a_i+1).
\]
Here each \(a_i=3\), so the count is
\[
(2\cdot 3+1)^3=7^3=343.
\]

\[
\boxed{343}
\]
